name: Hanley's Foods
old_description: Hanley’s makes premium, natural salad dressings with a taste of Louisiana.
about:
Founded in 2010 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, Hanley's Foods began as a salad-loving venture by Richard and Kate Hanley, who launched their first dressing at the Red Stick Farmer's Market in 2012 after discovering their favorite restaurant-style dressing was unavailable in stores. The couple, together since high school, refined their recipe through family taste tests before partnering with the LSU AgCenter's Food Incubator to bring the product to market.

The company produces premium, all-natural salad dressings and croutons from scratch at its Louisiana facility, using locally sourced ingredients. Hanley's focuses exclusively on these two product lines, manufacturing every bottle in-house. Today its products are stocked in more than 2,000 retail locations across the United States, including major chains such as Walmart, Costco, Whole Foods, and regional grocers like Rouses Markets.

Hanley's serves the retail grocery sector and foodservice operators, with customers ranging from national big-box retailers to hospitality groups such as Compass Group and Royal Caribbean. The company also offers wholesale partnerships for independent grocers and specialty stores.

The founders say their differentiation lies in a single-minded commitment to quality: premium natural ingredients, Louisiana-made production, and adherence to rigorous food-safety standards including HACCP, NSF, SQF, GMP, and supporting programs such as SOP, SSOP, CCP, and CAP.
built_on: Single-focus on premium salad dressings and croutons
